pages.title: Carousel four · 1/3
paragraphs: It is nine at night at a busy airport in Atlanta. Tired travelers stand around a moving belt. Suitcases come out one by one. Dan watches every bag with hope. A woman in a blue uniform walks by. Her badge says Rita.
“Excuse me, where is the baggage claim for flight 210?” says Rita. “It is at carousel four, down the hall.” says Rita. “Thank you. Is it far from here?” says Rita.
